content.text:
I'd go with the third one, but I'm not really sure about it. It had the fewest numbers on each line. It's still not something I'd put our money in.

**My thoughts as I went**

- First screen. At the top it says "קרנות סל". I don't know that word, and right underneath are English letters, S, and, P, 500, M-S-C-I. My first feeling is that this isn't for me. But I was asked to choose, so I kept going.
- It's a black background with grey writing. The column headings "שם הקרן", "מספר נייר" and "במה הכסף מושקע" are pale, and I had to lean in to read them.
- The "דמי ניהול" column I understood. "קבועים 0.35%", "משתנים 0.1%". Those are fees. But under them, in every row, there's "נאמן 0.008%". What's נאמן? I skipped it.
- "120%" stopped me. How can anything be more than 100%? It sounds dangerous. On the first screen "מניות עד 120%" appears in every row, and I read it again four times just to see that it's the same each time.
- The labels under the names repeat too: "מחזיקה את המניות", "עסקת החלף", "חשיפה לדולר", "מס גם על שינויי המטבע". I don't know what עסקת החלף is. And "מס גם על שינויי המטבע" worried me.
- Second screen. There's one column fewer, but a line was added in pale grey: "פרופיל 4A: מניות עד 120%, מט"ח עד 10%". I don't know what 4A or "פרופיל" means. That small grey line is the hardest thing on the page to read.
- Third screen. On the left there's only "מט"ח עד 10%" or "מט"ח עד 120%". Less repetition, and I could quickly see that the first two rows differ from the last two. That's why I'd choose it.
- What stayed with me: the last two cost 0.8%, which is the most, and they have 120% in foreign currency. I'd back away from those.
- There are two notes at the bottom. One talks about "לא מחלקות", which I didn't understand. The other is about "החשיפה המרבית". I read them and they didn't help.
- I didn't press "בדף הקרן במאיה" or the green arrows. I don't know what "מאיה" is.
- I didn't get tired on three screens. But I would have run away on the first one if I hadn't been asked to stay.
